items.caption: Компактное сердце · яркая медь
items.prompt:
Generate a completely NEW original fictional face from scratch, no image inputs. A genuinely photographic ALIVE casting portrait of EMMA, a beautiful FIFTEEN-YEAR-OLD older adolescent with a compact youthful face, vivid naturally RED-COPPER long hair, clear PALE BLUE irises and pale lightly freckled skin. These colors are strongly distinct and luminous: copper-red rather than brown/blond, clear blue rather than dull grey. Natural healthy skin color, no makeup, no luminous neon eyes, no global HDR. A self-assured proper girl with cool assessing eyes and a quietly stubborn closed mouth; emotionally controlled, not dreamy, not smiling or fashion-posing. Upper chest portrait, opaque white fine-knit blouse closed at neck with a small restrained lace collar, ladybird pendant on a thin silver chain. Fully age-appropriate, no adult wrinkles or body development, no glamour styling.

Living skin with fine irregular pores by the nose, finer matte outer cheeks and forehead, natural delicate eyelids, soft lip lines and sparse irregular freckles. No plastic/wax, airbrushing, procedural pore-noise, heavy grain, sharpening halos, fake eyelashes or glossy lips. Broad softly directional NEUTRAL light with weak bounce and a gently darker shadow side; natural color separation between copper hair, ivory face and light-blue eyes. Quiet matte pale-gray inhabited station-study background, softly defocused cabinet, no polished sci-fi corridor or decorative bulbs. Face sharper than fabric and background. The visual appeal is slightly storybook-like through rich natural color and harmonious compact features, while rendering is an unretouched photograph of a real teenager.

Vertical 2:3, 1024x1536, head and shoulders, normal 85mm-equivalent perspective and f5.6 optical depth. COMPLETE head and highest hair strand within frame with ten percent clear background above. Do not elongate the midface or chin. Long natural red waves partly gathered behind ears, no celebrity hairdo. No text, watermark, collage, hands or extra people.

DISTINCT ORIGINAL FACIAL ANATOMY:
A compact heart-shaped face with a broad gentle forehead, rounded upper cheeks, small SHORT rounded chin and narrow soft lower jaw. Slightly wide-set BLUE eyes with rounded openings and straight, slightly heavy upper lids, no upswept outer corners; natural fairly dense STRAIGHT copper brows with a small irregular gap on one side. Medium-width short nose with a visible ordinary bridge and softly wide rounded tip, not a tiny pointed nose. Relatively wide closed mouth with a THIN straight upper lip, very shallow cupid bow and a fuller lower lip, one corner slightly lower. Modest ears slightly visible. Face directed nearly frontally, level skeptical gaze. Individuality comes from the unusual combination of rounded eyes, straight strong brows and broad-tipped short nose; ordinary subtle asymmetry.
